description: Previously recorded CP2K development validation. Not a new timing campaign. Detailed development provenance is retained separately in local working records.

al_cg_response.caveat: The historical record describes the functional/potential combination as PBE/PADE. Recover the original full input before final publication; do not silently label it pure PBE or LDA. Single reported timings have no error bars.

direct_hxc_kernel.caveat: Direct kernel cost can increase elapsed time. These cases are not interchangeable with other Cu/Ni companions.

compatibility.source: Recorded 100-case direct metallic OT compatibility audit, 31 August 2026
compatibility.caveat: Recorded development audit; original 100-row run manifest must be archived before this result is treated as a publication benchmark.

kpoint_symmetry.source: Previously documented Al full-mesh and symmetry-reduced comparisons
kpoint_symmetry.caveat: Transcribed endpoint records, not newly run calculations. Pointwise density-difference norms and paired electron-number residuals are not available. Recover original inputs and outputs before treating these as a complete reproducible symmetry-validation dataset.

lattice_fft_application.source: Transcribed five-repeat gathered/distributed lattice-FFT application comparison
lattice_fft_application.energy_agreement: Within MPI-distribution roundoff; numerical endpoints not transcribed
lattice_fft_application.caveat: Historical medians, not new timings. Both implementations use FFT preconditioning. This is not FFT versus a conventional operator, not a metal benchmark, and not evidence of general end-to-end acceleration. Original temporary input and per-run output paths are no longer present. Raw distributions, uncertainty estimates, hardware details and complete build provenance remain to be archived or replaced by explicitly new calculations.

motion.caveat: One-step lifecycle check, not a long-time energy-conservation study.
